summary: Iteration 26 - favicons, CA chip, header crowding, no-wallet + in-wallet swaps, branding audit. Backend pytest (tests/test_iter26_brand_ds.py): all 6 favicon URLs return the NullCash mark (black centre, no purple pixels), manifest is correct, DS tokens/quotes/order/status work live, NEAR tokens/quote work. NEAR order creation returns 503 from upstream ('An active incident has unverified route impact. New orders ... paused'). That is upstream, not an app bug. Frontend: the landing and /docs CA chip works at 1920 and 390 (copy plus check icon, no overflow), but the short form wraps onto 2 lines at 390. The /app CA chip is in .top-right before X and the wallet button on every hash tab (full form >=1600, short form below). No overlap at 1920/1600/1440/1280, both with a simulated connected label and with a real in-app NullCash vault. The wallet button is capped at 240px with an ellipsis. The More menu shows the overflow tabs and navigates correctly. BUG: at viewport widths 1024-1080 every top tab collapses to an empty 26px pill with no label. Private route UI: live 3 routes, rate, ETA, limits, Order created modal with deposit address and 30 min countdown; Track shows WAITING FOR DEPOSIT plus steps. Privacy swap UI: live quote works; order creation is blocked by the upstream 503 and the UI shows the raw upstream message (no 'Use Private route' fallback). In-wallet Swap SOL->jlUSDC amount 1: live quote 98.597 jlUSDC; Relayer fee 0.001103 SOL; NullCash fee 0.3% 0.002996 SOL; minimum received shown. Send and Shield load with fee rows. No pageerrors. Branding audit (title, innerText, alt/aria/title/placeholder) on /, /docs, /app/api, /app/docs, /app/security and all /app hash tabs: 0 hits. /app/api now shows 'Intent network' and '@usenullcash' -> x.com/usenullcash.

minor.issue: Upstream returns 503 'An active incident has unverified route impact. New orders and funding guidance are conservatively paused'. The proxy passes it through. Upstream outage, not an app bug, but see the UI fallback item.
Response JSON key is 'houdiniId'. Not displayed, but it is a brand name in the API payload. Consider renaming it to 'id'.
Token icon URLs are /api/bifrost/v1/_img?k=<base64>. The base64 decodes to https://api.houdiniswap.com/... so the upstream brand can be recovered trivially. Consider an opaque key or a hash.
Token name 'Jupiter Perpetuals Liquidity Provider Token' (JLP) contains 'Jupiter'. It is the real token name, so it is acceptable unless strict brand removal is wanted.

ui_bugs.issue: At viewport widths 1024-1080px every .nav-i becomes an empty 26px pill with no visible label (Home/Shield/Swap... unreadable; only 'More' is readable). fitNav doesn't move anything to overflow because nothing overflows. RCA: the upstream mirrored CSS has a max-width:1080px rule that hides the label <span> (icon-only rail mode), while nc-theme.css (min-width:1024px block) hides the icon `nav.side .nav-i>i{display:none!important}`. Result: neither icon nor label shows. Suggested fix in nc-theme.css inside @media(min-width:1024px): `nav.side .nav-i>span:not(.dk-nw){display:inline!important}` (or show the label for 1024-1080). Then fitNav overflow handles the width.

When /api/ds/near/orders fails (503 upstream incident), the card shows the raw upstream text 'An active incident has unverified route impact...' in a red box. It shows no friendly message and no 'Use Private route' fallback button. That fallback seems to exist only for quote failures, not order-creation failures.

Has no CA chip (no nav-ca-chip/nc-ca-chip and no '31GY' text), but the requirement is the CA on ALL pages. /app/docs and /app/security do have nav-ca-chip. /app/api also showed a blank screen at ~2.5s after navigation in one run; the content appeared in an earlier run after 3.5s.
At 390px the short CA '31GY…pump' wraps onto two lines (span height 36px, white-space normal). Add whitespace-nowrap to the chip/nav-ca-short span in CaChip.jsx.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the empty tab pills at 1024-1080px in nc-theme.css. Show the label span (not .dk-nw) for nav.side .nav-i at min-width:1024px, because upstream max-width:1080 hides it and our CSS hides the icon.
Privacy swap: on order-creation failure (5xx/incident) show a friendly message and the 'Use Private route' fallback button instead of the raw upstream text.
Show numeric fees for Private route/Privacy swap (e.g. app fee 0.4% from appFeeBps, withdraw fee) instead of only 'In quote'.
CaChip.jsx: add whitespace-nowrap so '31GY…pump' doesn't wrap at 390px.
Optional brand hygiene: rename the 'houdiniId' key, make the _img?k= key opaque (it base64-decodes to api.houdiniswap.com), and rename the '#veilswap' hash for Bridge.
critical_code_review_comments: fitNav() relies on nav.scrollWidth > clientWidth. It can't detect items that are visually broken (labels hidden by upstream CSS), so add a check that tab labels are visible, or force labels on.
dk-swap.js is ~1745 lines; consider splitting into modules (nav/header, tour, swap, splash).

rca of the issue: Empty tabs at 1024-1080: the upstream app CSS (@media max-width:1080px) collapses the sidebar to icon-only by hiding the .nav-i label span. NullCash's desktop top-bar CSS (@media min-width:1024px) hides .nav-i>i icons. In the 1024-1080 overlap both are hidden, so each tab renders as a 26px empty pill (padding 0 13px). Reproduce: open /app at 1060x800 and evaluate the nav.side .nav-i widths (all 26px). Mitigation: force the label visible in the min-width:1024 block.
